name: plain-chinese
description: Forces plain, jargon-free Simplified Chinese in Claude Code's output. Bans internet and workplace buzzwords (根因, 兜底, 对齐, 抓手, 闭环, 赋能…) and AI-tic phrasing (不是X而是Y, 本质上, 综上所述) while keeping real technical terms. Ships as an output style; force-for-plugin applies it automatically once enabled.
